description: Plaatselijke hoofdstukken en bestaande beelden gelezen en bekeken; nieuwe resultaten gecontroleerd op inhoud, anatomie en leesbaarheid.

images.alt: Beeldspraak: ijs en sneeuw loven — Gezang in de vuuroven 1:72; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Nature photography illustrating the poetic invitations in the Song in the Furnace, landscape 3:2, natural accurate forms, no people, writing, divine human face or modern objects. A tranquil winter mountain lake with clear ice at the edge, white snow on rocks and distant mountain peaks, pale early morning sky, accurate snow and ice textures. A poetic nature illustration of the invitation to ice and snow to praise in verse 72; no anthropomorphic faces, musical notes, people or literal speaking landscape.

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Nature photography illustrating the poetic invitations in the Song in the Furnace, landscape 3:2, natural accurate forms, no people, writing, divine human face or modern objects. Several small wild birds fly across a natural bright sky above an ancient Mediterranean wetland, one graceful heron glides low above reeds while a few smaller birds remain distant. Accurate wings and feet, no extra limbs, natural scale and no domestic cages. A poetic illustration of the invitation to all birds in verse 80, not a literal choir or a named historical event.

images.alt: De kring van lof met gecontroleerde tekstgegevens.

rows: Eén stem van lof tot de God van de vaderen, in tempel en hemel.
Werken, engelen, hemel, water, lichtdragers, regen, wind, hitte, kou, ijs en wolken.
Bergen, planten, bronnen, zeeën, rivieren, waterdieren, vogels, wilde dieren en vee.
Mensen, Israël, priesters, dienaren, rechtvaardigen, nederigen en de drie geredden.
design.note: Ananias, Azaria en Misaël worden in vers 88 genoemd. De schepping wordt poëtisch tot lof uitgenodigd.
